items.title: Bullish Stock Is Set to Win Whatever Happens to Crypto Law, Analyst Says
items.summary: A Wall Street analyst thinks Bullish stands to benefit whether the Clarity Act passes or not. The Senate will vote Tuesday on whether to advance the bill.

items.title: Should You Buy Coinbase Stock While Its Revenue Is Shrinking?
items.summary: Coinbase Global (COIN) stock has gained about 18% over the past month, and it is still down about 44% over the past year. At about $175 a share, the market pays 7.3 times sales against 3.2 for the S&P 500, more than double the market's price for revenue that is shrinking. The question is whether what Coinbase is building is worth more than what it is losing.

items.title: HOOD's August Metrics Strong Amid Mixed Trading Trends: What's Ahead?
items.summary: Robinhood's August metrics showed strong customer, asset and equity growth, while mixed trading trends kept transaction-based revenue risks in focus.

items.title: Interactive Brokers Expands Global Footprint: Is IBKR Stock a Buy?
items.summary: IBKR's global expansion, 35% account growth and scalable tech support its outlook, though a 30.22X forward P/E raises valuation risk. Is now the time to buy it?

items.title: Robinhood's New Blockchain Is Now Making More Money Than Ethereum. Does That Make Robinhood Stock a Buy?

items.title: Robinhood CEO Claps Back At AMC Chief As Stock Tokenization Debate Heats Up — Says Companies Should Control Share Rights, Not 'Every Lawful Use'
items.summary: Vlad Tenev argued that everyone should have access to high-quality financial assets, irrespective of their geographical domicile, adding that Robinhood stock tokenization via its onchain technology makes that “vision real at global scale, starting with US stocks.”
